verdict.rationale: The API is clearly versioned: endpoints live under /v2/jobs, the docs are organized as "jobs-v2", and there is a v2 changelog that records additions such as auth and health endpoints and a cancel webhook. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or how older versions are retired, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version support windows, migration guidance between versions, and independent corroboration.
